@@ -1,15 +0,0 @@
-cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22.1)
-project(discovery)
-#foreach (_variableName ${_variableNames})
-#   message(STATUS "${_variableName}=${${_variableName}}")
-#endforeach()
-find_package(OpenCL REQUIRED)
-# Generate the properties file for Maven
-# Note: ${OpenCL_LIBRARY} and ${OpenCL_INCLUDE_DIR} are set by find_package
-file(WRITE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/opencl_paths.properties"
-    "mac.frameworks.dir=${CMAKE_C_IMPLICIT_LINK_FRAMEWORK_DIRECTORIES}\n"
-    "opencl.found=${OpenCL_FOUND}\n"
-    "opencl.header=${OpenCL_INCLUDE_DIR}\n"
-    "opencl.lib=${OpenCL_LIBRARY}\n"
-    "opencl.version=${OpenCL_VERSION_STRING}\n"
-)

+<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 http://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
+  <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>
+  <packaging>jar</packaging>
+  <groupId>oracle.code</groupId>
+  <version>1.0</version>
+  <artifactId>hat-ex-opencl</artifactId>
+  <parent>
+    <groupId>oracle.code</groupId>
+    <artifactId>hat-ex</artifactId>
+    <version>1.0</version>
+  </parent>
+  <build>
+    <plugins>
+      <plugin>
+        <groupId>org.codehaus.mojo</groupId>
+        <artifactId>exec-maven-plugin</artifactId>
+        <executions>
+          <execution>
+            <id>cmake-discovery</id>
+            <phase>initialize</phase>
+            <goals>
+              <goal>exec</goal>
+            </goals>
+          </execution>
+          <execution>
+            <id>jextract</id>
+            <phase>generate-sources</phase>
+            <goals>
+              <goal>exec</goal>
+            </goals>
+            <configuration>
+              <executable>jextract</executable>
+              <arguments>
+                <argument>-F</argument>
+                <argument>${mac.frameworks.dir}</argument>
+                <argument>--target-package</argument>
+                <argument>opencl</argument>
+                <argument>--output</argument>
+                <argument>${project.build.directory}/generated-sources/java</argument>
+                <argument>--library</argument>
+                <argument>:${opencl.lib}</argument>
+                <argument>${opencl.header}/Headers/opencl.h</argument>
+              </arguments>
+            </configuration>
+          </execution>
+        </executions>
+      </plugin>
+      <plugin>
+        <groupId>org.codehaus.mojo</groupId>
+        <artifactId>properties-maven-plugin</artifactId>
+        <executions>
+          <execution>
+            <phase>initialize</phase>
+            <goals>
+              <goal>read-project-properties</goal>
+            </goals>
+          </execution>
+        </executions>
+      </plugin>
+      <plugin>
+        <groupId>org.codehaus.mojo</groupId>
+        <artifactId>build-helper-maven-plugin</artifactId>
+        <version>3.6.0</version>
+        <executions>
+          <execution>
+            <id>add-source</id>
+            <phase>generate-sources</phase>
+            <goals>
+              <goal>add-source</goal>
+            </goals>
+          </execution>
+        </executions>
+      </plugin>
+    </plugins>
+  </build>
+</project>
